title: This actually helped me create a routine
body: I was looking for a good app to help me create a routine and I stumbled upon this one. I got a couple of other apps to try but they all made me put my email in and I didn’t want that so I love that I don’t need to put my email in or create an account on the app. It is just very straightforward. The only thing I don’t like is that it advertises the “pro” version and sometimes it doesn’t let me create a new task but usually I just wait and after a couple of minutes I can create a new one. I recommend this app
author: fannfrur

title: Very good
body: The only planner app that I actually follow and put stuff in. Really recommend
